gateReasons: 6 finding(s) at or above "high" (3 critical, 3 high).

checks.title: Project discovery
checks.summary: Detected no known framework across 2 files (JavaScript 1).

checks.title: Environment file and git hygiene
checks.summary: Environment files are ignored and no sensitive filenames were found in reachable history.
checks.details: Git history scanning is disabled by default. Enable scan.gitHistory to check sensitive filenames in history.

checks.title: Hardcoded secrets and credentials
checks.summary: No credential patterns detected across 2 scannable files.

checks.title: Static security review
checks.summary: No risky source patterns matched across 2 text files. This is not a proof of security.
checks.details: Static rules are heuristics for human review; they do not execute or prove exploitability.

checks.title: Dependency vulnerability audit
checks.summary: No package.json was found, so there are no npm dependencies to audit.

checks.title: Build and configuration safety
checks.summary: No unsafe build or debug configuration flags detected.

checks.title: Repository hygiene
checks.summary: 4 repository hygiene item(s) need attention.

findings.title: No .gitignore file
findings.description: The project does not define a .gitignore, so build output, dependencies, and environment files can be committed accidentally.
findings.impact: Secrets and large generated directories can enter version control.
findings.remediation: Add a .gitignore covering node_modules, build output, and .env files.

findings.title: Missing README file
findings.description: The repository has no README.md.
findings.impact: New contributors and users lack orientation.
findings.remediation: Add a README.md file.

findings.title: Missing license file
findings.description: The repository has no LICENSE.
findings.impact: Without a license, others have no clear legal right to use the project.
findings.remediation: Add a LICENSE file.

findings.title: No continuous integration workflow
findings.description: No GitHub Actions or GitLab CI configuration was found.
findings.impact: Checks depend on local discipline and regressions can reach the default branch.
findings.remediation: Add a CI workflow that installs from the lockfile and runs lint, typecheck, tests, and build.

checks.title: Cookie security attributes
checks.summary: 2 cookie attribute issue(s) found.

findings.title: Cookie "session" is missing HttpOnly
findings.description: A response cookie is readable from JavaScript.
findings.impact: Any XSS on the site can steal this cookie and hijack the session.
findings.remediation: Set HttpOnly on session and authentication cookies.

findings.title: Cookie "session" has no SameSite policy
findings.description: The cookie does not declare SameSite, leaving cross-site sending behavior to browser defaults.
findings.impact: Cross-site request forgery protection is weaker and browser-dependent.
findings.remediation: Set SameSite=Lax or Strict unless the cookie is required for a cross-site flow.

checks.title: CORS policy
checks.summary: 1 permissive CORS behavior(s) observed.

findings.title: Wildcard CORS with credentials
findings.description: The server allows any origin together with credentials.
findings.impact: Any website can make authenticated cross-origin requests and read the responses where browsers permit it.
findings.remediation: Replace the wildcard with an allowlist of trusted origins and never combine credentials with "*".

checks.title: Error handling and information disclosure
checks.summary: 1 error-handling issue(s) observed.

findings.title: Error responses disclose internal details
findings.description: A request to a random path returned content containing stack-trace or internal error markers.
findings.impact: File paths, framework versions, and internal logic help attackers target exploits.
findings.remediation: Disable debug error pages in production and return a generic error response with a correlation ID.

evidence.label: Validation
evidence.value: Body contained stack-trace or internal error markers.

checks.title: HTTP security headers
checks.summary: 5 security header(s) missing or weak.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header is missing
findings.description: The response does not define a Content-Security-Policy, so the browser applies no restriction on script, style, frame, or connection sources.
findings.impact: Injected scripts have fewer obstacles and XSS impact is amplified.
findings.remediation: Add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy. Start with default-src 'self' and allow only the origins the application needs.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options is missing
findings.description: Browsers may MIME-sniff responses, which can turn an uploaded text file into executable script.
findings.impact: Content sniffing can enable script execution from user-uploaded content.
findings.remediation: Set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response.

findings.title: Clickjacking protection is missing
findings.description: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors restricts embedding of this page.
findings.impact: The application can be embedded in an attacker-controlled page and used for clickjacking.
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN) and a CSP frame-ancestors directive.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy is missing
findings.description: No referrer policy is set, so full URLs may leak to third parties and across origins.
findings.impact: Tokens or identifiers in URLs can leak through the Referer header.
findings.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin or no-referrer.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy is missing
findings.description: The response does not restrict access to browser features such as camera, microphone, and geolocation.
findings.impact: Embedded or compromised content has broader browser capabilities than necessary.
findings.remediation: Add a Permissions-Policy that disables features the app does not use.

checks.title: Transport encryption
checks.summary: Loopback target uses HTTP; transport encryption is not applicable to local development.

checks.title: API contract verification
checks.summary: 2 endpoint request(s) executed; 1 contract issue(s) found.

findings.title: GET /api/users accepts unauthenticated requests
findings.description: The endpoint is marked as requiring authentication, but an anonymous request returned HTTP 200.
findings.impact: Private data or actions may be available without a session.
findings.remediation: Enforce authentication server-side before reading or mutating protected data.

checks.title: Object-level authorization
checks.summary: 1 cross-identity scenario(s) tested; 1 authorization failure(s) observed.

findings.title: Possible broken object-level authorization: User 2 profile
findings.description: other accessed a resource owned by owner and received HTTP 200; expected 401 or 403 or 404.
findings.impact: Users may read or modify other users' data by changing an identifier or URL. This is one of the most common and damaging application vulnerabilities.
findings.remediation: Enforce object ownership on the server for every request. Never rely on client-side checks or unguessable identifiers.

checks.title: Internal links
checks.summary: 5 internal link(s) checked; 1 broken.

findings.title: Broken internal link: /broken
findings.description: Linked from /; returned HTTP 404.
findings.impact: Users following the link reach an error page.
findings.remediation: Update the link or restore the route, and add a link check to CI.

checks.details: Only same-origin links found on sampled pages are checked. External links and JavaScript-driven navigation are not covered.

checks.title: Mobile layout
checks.summary: 1 mobile layout issue(s) observed.

findings.title: Horizontal overflow on /
findings.description: The page is 1072px wide in a 390px viewport, causing horizontal scrolling.
findings.impact: Mobile users must pan sideways and content may be clipped.
findings.remediation: Constrain wide elements, use max-width: 100%, and test at the configured mobile viewport.

checks.details: Overflow detection only; this is not a full responsive or touch-target audit.

checks.title: Browser page load
checks.summary: The application loaded in Chromium without observed console or network errors.

checks.title: Browser user workflows
checks.summary: 1 workflow(s) passed and 0 failed.

findings.description: Deliberate demo console error for LaunchProof
findings.impact: Console errors often precede broken user flows and indicate unhandled failures.
findings.remediation: Fix the underlying error and keep the console clean for tested pages.

checks.title: Accessibility (axe-core)
checks.summary: 3 page(s) scanned with tags wcag2a, wcag2aa; 1 violation(s) found.

findings.title: Accessibility: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
findings.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds This is an automated rule match; manual review with assistive technology is still required.
findings.impact: Users relying on assistive technology may be unable to complete this part of the page.
findings.remediation: Fix the reported elements and re-run axe. See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.14/color-contrast?application=axeAPI

Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.19 (foreground color: #70747c, background color: #24272d, font size: 9.8pt (13px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

checks.details: Automated checks cover only a subset of WCAG. Manual keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, and contrast testing is still required.

limitations: Static analysis is heuristic. Pattern matches indicate code worth reviewing; they do not prove exploitability, and no finding does not prove safety.
Secret values are masked before entering the report. Masking still means a credential may have leaked; rotate anything confirmed.
HTTP checks were unauthenticated unless configured identities were executed. Authenticated areas may behave differently.
TLS certificate chains, protocol versions, and cipher configuration were not independently assessed in this version.
Browser checks exercise only the configured workflows and sampled pages; untested flows and states remain unverified.
Performance measurements are single-run observations from this machine and network, not a production benchmark.
Database policies were assessed statically only, if at all; deployed RLS behavior was not verified.
